requirements.title: Unallocated allocatable variables are not referenced or defined
requirements.definition: An allocatable variable with unallocated allocation status is outside the conforming source boundary for reference or definition. This restriction is about allocation status, not allocation syntax or the value that a later allocation stores.

pending.allocated-reference-control: PENDING positive control: allocate integer allocatable a(-1:1), assign distinct values 11, 13 and 17, read them back into sentinel variables and check exact values and bounds.
pending.allocated-definition-control: PENDING positive control: allocate scalar integer allocatable a initialized by assignment to -5, define a = 29 and check 29 through ALLOCATED(a) plus value comparison.
pending.unallocated-source-boundary: PENDING source-use inventory records deallocated or never-allocated reference/definition examples as nonconforming source contrasts only; no diagnostic is required by this unnumbered shall.

requirements.oracle: Positive controls establish allocated status before every reference or definition and use nondefault sentinels and exact integer values.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Executing a reference or definition of an unallocated allocatable variable is nonconforming, and this unnumbered shall does not require a processor diagnostic. Runtime traps, stale storage contents and diagnostic wording are not portable evidence.
requirements.dependencies: 9.7.1.3 and 9.7.3.2 define allocation and deallocation effects; 16.9 ALLOCATED can observe defined allocation status; coarray cobounds and team facets remain with 5.4.7, 5.4.8 and 8.5.6.

accounting.rationale: Defines allocated/unallocated allocation status and points to 9.7.1.3 and 9.7.3.2 for status transitions. ALLOCATED inquiry plans belong with allocation/deallocation catalogues.
Defines declared rank/corank with bounds/cobounds determined by allocation. Allocation-time bounds and cobounds are owned by 9.7.1.3 and coarray declaration/allocation catalogues.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4.7-5.4.11 and 5.5-5.5.7 of the Clause 5 overview (batch250). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; restated rules are cross-referenced to their owning catalogues, R516 had no existing tests, and processor-dependent text is latitude.
